user.title: Connect your MG (India)
user.description: Sign in with the same details you use in the MG iSMART India app. Every login counts against MG's daily limit, so check the details before submitting.

data_description.phone: The 10-digit Indian mobile number registered in the MG app.
data_description.pin: Needed for lock/unlock, air conditioning and find-my-car. Only a hash of it is stored.
data_description.vin: Leave empty to use the first car on your account.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: MG rejected the saved login for {phone}. Enter the current MG app password.

error.invalid_auth: MG rejected the mobile number or password.
error.mfa_required: This MG account has two-step login turned on. Turn it off in the MG app and try again.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be the 4-digit MG app PIN.
error.vin_not_found: That VIN is not on this MG account.
error.no_vehicle: No car was found on this MG account.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the MG iSMART India service. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This car is already set up.

data.pin: New 4-digit app PIN (leave empty to keep the current one)

data_description.scan_interval: Each refresh wakes the car's telematics unit; 10 minutes is a good balance.
